name: retirement-planner
description: Lets Claude read, compare and stress-test your retirement plan with the planner's own engine, and (optionally) follow the plan open in your browser. Runs only on this computer; the plan is never changed.
long_description: Claude gets the planner's tools: list and compare scenarios, run stress tests and Monte Carlo as background jobs, try what-ifs and market paths, and hand you proposals to review in the app (🤖 LLM). Choose a saved plan file, or turn on the live bridge (still in development) and connect the open planner page (🤖 LLM → Live bridge) so Claude works on the plan on your screen. Everything is calculated by the planner's engine in today's dollars; your plan is read-only and nothing leaves your computer except what Claude is shown in the chat.

plan_file.title: Plan file (optional)
plan_file.description: A plan you saved with Save in the planner. The file is only read, never changed. Leave empty to use only the live bridge.

live_bridge.title: Live bridge to the open planner page (in development)
live_bridge.description: Lets Claude work on the plan on your screen. After installing, open the planner page, choose 🤖 LLM → Live bridge, and enter the port and pairing code (ask Claude: "check bridge_status").

bridge_port.title: Bridge port
bridge_port.description: Local port for the live bridge (1024-65535).

bridge_token.title: Pairing code (optional)
bridge_token.description: At least 12 letters or digits. Leave empty to get a random one that Claude can tell you.

show_names.title: Show people's names to Claude
show_names.description: Off: names appear as Person 1 / Person 2.
